description: This file defines a visual component named 'EditorPane' using LightningJS's Blits framework. It manages the editing interface for notes, including title and content editing, autosave functionality, delete confirmation dialog, and user interaction handling.

classes.name: Component
classes.description: A LightningJS Blits component representing the note editor interface.

methods.name: autosave
methods.description: Saves the current note content and title via NoteService and updates the last saved timestamp.

methods.name: focusTitle
methods.description: Sets cursor to title input field.

methods.name: focusContent
methods.description: Sets cursor to content input field.

methods.name: $confirmDelete
methods.description: Confirms or cancels the delete action depending on user input.
